related_work.campaign_objective: MNCS Environmental Capability Intelligence & Continuous Improvement Campaign
related_work.work_intent_goal: Improve MNCS's ability to observe, interpret, and improve how the environment serves agents working within MNCS.

observation.source_interface: MNCS Environment selected-session context and capability availability snapshot

request.operation: make a selected-session unavailable capability cause discoverable during first-use context without returning to the full binding inventory

outcome.implementation_scope: Existing Session.context capability summary and its first-use documentation
outcome.implementation_change: First-use context now lists at most eight explicit unavailable binding summaries with validated stable identifiers, reason codes, observation time, verification basis, and safe repository/environment resolution facts. It omits free-text reasons and paths, reports omitted items, and aggregates a bounded set of unknown reason-code counts separately from unavailable status.
outcome.verified_change: Three focused context regression tests pass. A post-commit read of the selected session exposes the exact unavailable mncs-test binding and its unselected mncs-compiler checkout dependency, while preserving 36 unknown bindings as a separate reason-code aggregate. The readback is explicitly labeled as a stored snapshot rather than a fresh probe.
outcome.interpretation_limit: The interface and covered output behavior are verified for this session. Reduced agent intervention, recurrence, and cross-session usefulness have not been measured.

pressure_hypothesis.title: First-use context reports unavailable capability counts without exposing a bounded actionable cause
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment selected-session context and capability bindings
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: Expose a bounded binding-level availability summary in first-use context with stable resolution identifiers, while keeping unknown bindings distinct and omitting free-text reasons and filesystem paths.

improvement_relation.basis: The existing first-use context contract now carries a bounded and redacted availability-attention view, the focused regression test validates caps and distinction between unavailable and unknown states, and an authentic selected-session context readback exposes the recorded cause with its snapshot freshness. This establishes the behavior for this session only.
not_measured: Whether an independent agent completes relevant work with fewer inspection steps or lower reasoning burden.
Whether this issue recurs across sessions or other capability providers.
Whether the selected compiler checkout dependency was relevant to actual compiler development in this session.
Whether this context presentation changes service fulfillment or environmental reliability.
Long-term effect on capability discovery, support quality, or agent outcomes.
Whether the snapshot needs revalidation before an agent relies on an unavailable status.
